facts.quote: On March 5, 2020, Mullens was assigned a one-year, $750,000 exclusive-rights free agent tender by the 49ers. He signed the contract on May 1.
After not being selected in the 2023 NFL draft, Remigio signed with the Kansas City Chiefs as an undrafted free agent. He was waived/injured on August 29, 2023 and placed on injured reserve.
On April 19, 2022, Zaccheaus signed his right-of-refusal tender, ensuring his return to the Falcons.
Ali was selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the fifth round (165th overall) in the 2024 NFL draft. He was placed on injured reserve on September 5 due to a neck injury.
The Packers placed a second-round restricted free agent tender on Tonyan on March 17, 2021. On May 27, Tonyan signed his tender worth $3.4 million.
Roush was selected by the Chicago Bears in the third round, with the 69th overall pick, of the 2026 NFL Draft. He signed his rookie contract on July 10.
